name: @ugoite/ikasue
description: Planar adaptive UI components for information-dense workspaces.

scripts.check: prettier --check . && eslint . && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && npm run contract:check
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run contract:check
scripts.docs:build: npm --prefix docs-site run build && node scripts/check-docs-build.mjs && npm run contract:check
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/check-docs-sync.mjs && npm --prefix docs-site run check
